title: Store a name
summary: COBOL: Store a name. Try the four-letter name Ravi.
introduction: PIC X describes a character. A number in parentheses gives the field length.

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Store a name
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 STUDENT-NAME PIC X(4) VALUE "Asha".
procedure division.
DISPLAY STUDENT-NAME
stop run.

blocks.text: The four-character field contains exactly Asha.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Longer text needs a larger field or it will be cut short.
